title: Number Series & Pattern Recognition (Missing, Wrong Series & Polynomials)

### 🔢 Number Series Algorithmic Decomposition

1. **The Difference-Tree Algorithm:**
   • **Level 1 Difference ((Delta_1)):** If sequence grows slowly/linearly, compute consecutive differences.
   • **Level 2 Difference ((Delta_2)):** If (Delta_1) is not constant, compute second differences. Constant (Delta_2 implies) underlying quadratic pattern ((an^2 + bn + c)).
   • **Level 3 Difference ((Delta_3)):** Constant (Delta_3 implies) cubic pattern ((n^3 pm k)).
2. **Multiplication & Addition Patterns ((	imes k pm m)):**
   • Observe ratio between adjacent high-value terms: ( rac{T_n}{T_{n-1}}). If ratio is approximately 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, the pattern is (T_n = T_{n-1} 	imes k + f(n)).
3. **Wrong Number Series Diagnostic:**
   • In a single-error sequence, one incorrect term creates **TWO consecutive anomalous differences** in (Delta_1) and **THREE anomalous values** in (Delta_2). The term at the intersection of the anomaly is the wrong number!

🎯 Exam Angle → ⚡ Decimal Series Identification: When terms decrease slightly then expand rapidly (e.g. (10, 6, 7, 12, 26, 67.5)), immediately check the (	imes 0.5 + 1), (	imes 1 + 1), (	imes 1.5 + 1.5), (	imes 2 + 2) multiplier pattern.
